title: Mage and Dragon Egg
description: A white-haired female mage with purple eyes and ornate armor stands beside a large cracked white dragon egg. She holds a glowing red orb emitting purple magical energy above the egg, which rests on a bed of holly leaves and red gemstones.
prompt: A white-haired elven mage wearing purple and silver armor with glowing purple eyes stands on the right, reaching out with one hand to levitate a glowing red orb wrapped in swirling purple magic. In the center rests a large cracked white dragon egg surrounded by holly leaves and scattered red gemstones. The background features dark misty forest with purple berries and vines, dramatic fantasy lighting with magical particles, detailed digital painting style.
